note: Bridger-Teton NF campground in willows and aspen just off the NE shore of Half Moon Lake, ~9 mi NE of Pinedale via Fremont Lake Rd and Skyline Dr; the access road is not paved. Three sites have direct lake access and a sand beach runs along the campground's shore; boat launch ~1/2 mi down the road. Narrow access with limited turnaround - tight for large rigs. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 234785: $12 (2026/2027), 17 sites (11 reservable, 01-05 + 15 FCFS), all permit RV/trailer with 46-112 ft driveways, no hookups, two vault toilets, no water, no garbage service; FS season opens June 1 (rec.gov walk-up from May 11, FCFS to Sep 30); reservations close 7 days out. Lakeview kept: nearest mapped pads sit behind a willow line ~15-25 m above the beach.
flags: WATERFRONT (keep lakeview): rec.gov 'three of these provide direct lake access. Each site is well screened by willows'; FS 'Heavy willow stands provide excellent privacy between sites'. On Esri imagery the nearest catalog sites are 13 (42.93660,-109.76047; an RV visible on the pad) ~15 m of willow then a ~6 m sand beach from the water (~20 m in all), and 06 (42.93640,-109.76170), whose spur runs ~40 m down through trees to the beach. The FCFS sites 01-05 and 15 have no catalog coordinates, so the three lake-access sites could not be placed; with willows between every mapped pad and the shore, lakeview stays.

Phone 307-367-4326 confirmed (FS Pinedale Ranger District; rec.gov facility phone). Pin 42.9369,-109.7615 is ~35 m from the catalog centroid (42.93690,-109.76107) - no move. FS's own point (42.936513,-109.759356) sits ~150 m E on the access road.
